title: Design System: St Marys Village Dry Cleaners

display.purpose: Hero h1 only; roman weight 700, never italic.

headline.purpose: Section h2s across About, Why, Feature panel, Contact.

label.purpose: Uppercase small labels: footer headers, contact-list labels.

shadows.name: floating-affordance
shadows.purpose: Used only on the fixed call button so it reads as floating above any background.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for nearly all transitions (buttons, header, nav, reveal, lightbox).

motion.name: foil-sheen-sweep
motion.value: translateX(-120% -> 120%) over 0.7s using ease-out, gradient: linear-gradient(115deg, transparent 20%, rgba(255,255,255,.35) 40%, rgba(255,255,255,.05) 55%, transparent 70%)
motion.purpose: Universal hover/focus signature on buttons, service-row media, and gallery tiles; stands in for a shadow-lift.

motion.name: reveal-on-scroll
motion.value: opacity 0->1, translateY(24px)->0, 0.8s ease-out, via IntersectionObserver threshold 0.15
motion.purpose: Section content fade/rise on first scroll into view; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: accordion-expand
motion.purpose: FAQ accordion panel open/close, avoids animating max-height.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Forest-green filled CTA with a foil-sheen hover sweep; used for Call Now / Get in Touch actions.
components.css: .ds-btn { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6em; padding: 0.95em 1.9em; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; border-radius: 2px; text-decoration: none; overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate; transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 1; background: linear-gradient(115deg, transparent 20%, rgba(255,255,255,0.35) 40%, rgba(255,255,255,0.05) 55%, transparent 70%); transform: translateX(-120%); transition: transform 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); pointer-events: none; } .ds-btn:hover::before, .ds-btn:focus-visible::before { transform: translateX(120%); } .ds-btn:hover, .ds-btn:focus-visible { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn > * { position: relative; z-index: 2; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #254D43; color: #F3EFE6; border: 1px solid #254D43; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background: #1A362F; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent-outline CTA for secondary actions on dark grounds (hero, final CTA).
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.95em 1.9em; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; border-radius: 2px; text-decoration: none; background: transparent; color: #F3EFE6; border: 1px solid rgba(243,239,230,0.55); transition: background 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover, .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { background: rgba(243,239,230,0.12); }

components.name: Seam Divider
components.description: Dashed champagne hairline marking every section boundary, in place of a shadow or card edge.
components.css: .ds-seam { width: 100%; overflow: hidden; } .ds-seam svg { display: block; width: 100%; } .ds-seam line { stroke: #D7C8AE; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-dasharray: 2 7; stroke-linecap: round; }

components.name: Fixed Call Affordance
components.description: Pill-shaped, bottom-right fixed tel: link, the only persistent, never-relocated UI element and the only one carrying a resting shadow.
components.css: .ds-fixed-call { position: fixed; right: 2rem; bottom: 2rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6em; background: #254D43; color: #F3EFE6; text-decoration: none; padding: 0.85em 1.3em; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.88rem; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -8px rgba(20,24,26,0.45); transition: background 0.3s ease; } .ds-fixed-call:hover, .ds-fixed-call:focus-visible { background: #1A362F; }

components.name: Service Row
components.description: Alternating media/copy editorial row with a diagonal foil-sheen sweep over the image on hover; no card, no border.
components.html:
Professional Dry Cleaning

Everyday wear, delicates and formalwear are cleaned using modern dry-cleaning equipment and techniques.
components.css: .ds-service-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 1fr; gap: 3rem; align-items: center; } .ds-service-media { position: relative; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 2px; aspect-ratio: 5/4; } .ds-service-media img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-service-media::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 55%, rgba(215,200,174,0.28) 72%, transparent 88%); transform: translateX(-140%); transition: transform 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-service-row:hover .ds-service-media img { transform: scale(1.04); } .ds-service-row:hover .ds-service-media::after { transform: translateX(140%); } .ds-service-copy h3 { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.6rem; margin-bottom: 0.7rem; } .ds-service-copy p { color: #626762; }

components.name: Process Step
components.description: Oversized serif numeral as the dominant visual weight, with a thin champagne top-rule; reserved for the Process section's real 01-04 sequence.
components.html:
• 01

    Bring In Your Garments

    Drop by The Village Centre; drive-up access makes it easy.
components.css: .ds-process-step { position: relative; list-style: none; padding-top: 1.6rem; } .ds-process-step::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 1px; background: #D7C8AE; } .ds-step-num { display: block; font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 5vw, 3.6rem); color: #254D43; line-height: 1; margin-bottom: 0.6rem; } .ds-process-step h3 { font-size: 1.05rem; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; } .ds-process-step p { color: #626762; font-size: 0.95rem; }

components.name: Accordion Item
components.description: Borderless FAQ row with a hairline divider, a rotating plus-glyph, and a grid-rows expand animation.
components.html: Call or email us, or drop by in person.
components.css: .ds-accordion-item { border-bottom: 1px solid #D7C8AE; } .ds-accordion-trigger { width: 100%; text-align: left; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 1.3rem 2.2rem 1.3rem 0; font-size: 1.02rem; font-weight: 600; color: #202522; position: relative; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-accordion-trigger::after { content: '+'; position: absolute; right: 0; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 400; color: #254D43; transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-accordion-trigger[aria-expanded='true']::after { transform: translateY(-50%) rotate(45deg); } .ds-accordion-panel { display: grid; grid-template-rows: 0fr; transition: grid-template-rows 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); overflow: hidden; } .ds-accordion-item.is-open .ds-accordion-panel { grid-template-rows: 1fr; } .ds-accordion-panel > p { overflow: hidden; min-height: 0; color: #626762; }

narrative.overview: The site performs the service it sells: a visitor's scroll re-enacts a garment's own journey from worn to restored. It opens in a dim, warm-lit "before" register (near-black charcoal ground, a single warm key light) and resolves, section by section, through forest green into the brief-pinned warm-ivory "after" register — dawn breaking, felt in ground color rather than stated in copy. This is a premium-local, craft-driven world: a real independently run neighbourhood shop, not a chain or a laundromat app, so the system favors hairline structure, restrained motion, and licensed photography over iconography, cards, or drop shadows. Two literal tailoring motifs carry the identity in place of generic UI chrome: a dashed "seam-stitch" hairline divider marks every section boundary instead of a shadow or card edge, and a soft diagonal foil-sheen highlight sweeps across interactive surfaces on hover/focus, standing in for "pressed and finished" rather than a shadow-lift. Confirmed visual rejections carried through the build: no kicker/eyebrow label above the hero headline, no italic hero h1 (roman weight 700), no colored border-left accents, no Unicode star glyphs, no decorative sequence numbering outside the one section where a sequence is real (Process).
keyCharacteristics: A single continuous dark-to-ivory-to-forest tonal arc down the page, not a flat palette
Dashed champagne "seam" hairlines in place of shadows or cards at every section boundary
A restrained diagonal foil-sheen sweep on buttons, service rows, and gallery tiles on hover/focus
Oversized serif numerals (01-04) as the dominant visual weight in Process only
One fixed-position call affordance, bottom-right, that never relocates once revealed

rules.name: The Seam, Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Section boundaries are marked by a thread-thin dashed champagne line (stroke-dasharray: 2 7), never by a box-shadow, card edge, or background-color block alone.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Champagne never fills a surface; it only outlines, divides, or appears as a single-pixel rule or small glyph accent.

rules.name: The Roman-Headline Rule
rules.body: Primary display headlines (the hero h1) are set in roman weight 700, never italic; italic is reserved for small supporting flourishes that are explicitly secondary, not load-bearing claims.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; shadow appears only on the single persistent floating affordance, never on cards, buttons, or panels.

dos: Do mark every section boundary with the dashed champagne seam divider (stroke-dasharray: 2 7), not a shadow or card edge.
Do apply the diagonal foil-sheen hover sweep to any new interactive surface (buttons, media tiles, panels) as the system's one hover signature.
Do keep the hero h1 (and any primary display headline) roman weight 700, never italic.
Do reserve oversized sequence numerals for a section where the sequence is real (Process); do not add decorative numbering to list items elsewhere.
Do keep the fixed call affordance as the only element with a resting-state shadow and the only pill-radius element in the system.
Do author icons and rating glyphs as inline SVG <path> elements, never Unicode symbol characters or icon fonts.
donts: Don't add a kicker/eyebrow label above a primary headline — this was built, flagged in finish review, and removed; it is not a pattern to reuse.
Don't add a colored border-left accent to list items; the confirmed motif is a champagne hairline top-rule, matching Process and Why Choose Us.
Don't introduce a hard-offset/neobrutalist drop shadow anywhere; this is a flat, tonal-depth system.

Don't invent review content, star counts, pricing, or years-in-business figures in any new copy; the Reviews section intentionally shows only the sourced TrueLocal aggregate rating, linked out, with no fabricated testimonial text.
